findings.evidence: grep -n lMuNuOdd over the checkout returns only code/EpsilonEridani/QFT/Scattering/DIS/Tensors/Basic.lean:69 (plus the diff); Basic.lean:211 `def lMuNu ... := Bilin.rankOne g K.k K.kPrime + Bilin.rankOne g K.kPrime K.k - (g K.k K.kPrime) • g`.
findings.fix: Delete the `Leptonic.lMuNuOdd` reference (the leptonic tensor here is the symmetric `lMuNu` only), or point instead at the parity-odd structure that does exist, `Tensors.ParityOdd.Hadronic.Witness.aFour`.
findings.issue: The rewritten F₃ paragraph says "a parity-odd structure needs an alternating four-form supplied as data; the leptonic side does this in `Leptonic.lMuNuOdd`". No such declaration exists: the repo-wide grep for `lMuNuOdd` hits only this docstring line, and the `Leptonic` namespace (Basic.lean:204-226) defines only `lMuNu`, `lMuNu_apply`, `lMuNu_isSymm` — none of which involves an alternating form.

findings.evidence: ParityOdd.lean:212-217 `structure SpectatorPartners ... partner : ...`; the only plane-to-splitting bridge is ParityOdd.lean:221 `SpectatorPlane.spectatorSplitting ... : SpectatorSplitting g K`; grep for `SpectatorPartners` shows no instance constructed from `SpectatorPlane`.
findings.fix: Drop the trailing "the same holds under a `SpectatorPlane`" clause (the lemmas take `SpectatorPartners` and nothing more), or add and cite the extra definiteness hypothesis that would actually give `SpectatorPartners` from a plane.
findings.issue: The "Main results" bullet for `apply_pTransverse_eq_zero` / `apply_p_eq_zero` ends "...and every non-zero spectator is non-null with a non-null spectator orthogonal to it, the same holds under a `SpectatorPlane`." No lemma derives `SpectatorPartners` from `SpectatorPlane`, and the implication is false in general: `SpectatorPlane` only requires `e₁`, `e₂` non-null and mutually orthogonal, so with `g e₁ e₁ = 1`, `g e₂ e₂ = -1` the non-zero spectator `e₁ + e₂` is null and `partner` fails.

summary: Two inaccurate documentation claims: the Tensors/Basic.lean module docstring cites a declaration (`Leptonic.lMuNuOdd`) that does not exist, and the ParityOdd module docstring asserts a `p_T`/`p` annihilation result under `SpectatorPlane` that is neither proved nor implied by the definitions.
